card.name: Linking words before renal function terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "in" or "to" right before "renal function" or kidney-monitoring terms, mainly in warnings about worsening kidney function.

modes.label: Signs of worsening
modes.description: The word "of" after "signs" in instructions to monitor for worsening renal function.
modes.example: If celecoxib is used in patients with advanced renal disease, monitor patients for signs<< of>> worsening renal function

modes.label: Changes in renal function
modes.description: The word "in" after "changes" before renal function.
modes.example: Changes<< in>> renal function including acute renal failure can be

modes.label: Other kidney-lab links
modes.description: Linking or list words before kidney tests or dialysis timing.
modes.example: VEKLURY may be administered without regard<< to>> the timing of dialysis

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the text talks about kidney function getting worse or being monitored.
